name: Security For WooCommerce
author: Rizvi

sections.description:
Try out the security plugin for WooCommerce. Protect your online store against malicious actors by restricting your shop pages based on specific IP addresses and countries.

We believe that security should have the absolute minimum effect on your online store’s performance, user experience, and maintainability. Therefore, Security for WooCommerce is:

✅ Lightweight: Every security feature is developed with a modular approach and performance in mind. Disabled features won’t load any redundant code.

⚙️ Easy-to-use: The configuration options are some of the easiest-to-use settings available on WordPress.

Privacy Policy
The restricted IP, countries, etc information are stored on your server. No information is transmitted to third parties or remote server locations.
This plugin uses “http://www.geoplugin.net/php.gp?ip=” to detect users ip and restricts it by matching from your own database that you have selected You can find more about the service from the site “https://www.geoplugin.com/webservices/php”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  3. Go to the dashboard → Security for WooCommerce and you will find the new customization options.

  4. Customize the configuration options and apply the settings.
sections.faq:
What is Security for WooCommerce?

Security for WooCommerce is a WooCommerce extension plugin that allows store administrators to easily switch to any customer’s account view. This feature helps in understanding the customer experience and troubleshooting issues from their perspective.

Is Security for WooCommerce compatible with other WordPress themes?

Yes, Security for WooCommerce is compatible with most popular WooCommerce themes. We are continually working to ensure compatibility with even more themes to provide a seamless experience.

Is Security for WooCommerce compatible with WooCommerce?

Security for WooCommerce is tested to work effectively with WooCommerce and its features. While we aim for complete compatibility, if you encounter any issues, our support team is available to assist you.
